intro: The Villas at Flintrock is a gated group of Mediterranean style villas and condos in the 78738 area. CleanzATX offers window cleaning that fits the lock and leave lifestyle, and Tyler handles each job himself.

sections.h2: What Villas at Flintrock homes are like
paragraphs: The Villas at Flintrock are a small gated group of attached and clustered homes. The style is Mediterranean, with stucco walls, arches and tile roofs, and prices run from about $600K to $1M. This is a lock and leave setting, so many owners travel part of the year or keep a second home elsewhere. The Villas at Flintrock condo association handles the grounds and shared areas.

Villa living means a smaller footprint and less upkeep, but the glass still gets dirty. Windows are often arched or divided into smaller panes, and balconies and courtyards add glass doors on more than one side. Gated entry keeps traffic down, and the lots near the golf course are quiet most of the day.

Divided and arched windows hold dirt in the corners, and the stucco around them sheds a fine dust that drifts onto the glass. Sprinklers in the courtyards leave white mineral spots, and when a home sits empty for weeks, those spots bake in. Our dual RO, 4 stage pure water system with a DI resin tank brings water near 0 TDS, so glass dries clean with no spots and no soap film.

Pollen is a seasonal visitor, with cedar from December to February and live oak in March and April. Screens and tracks catch webs and grit. Screens are $5 each, tracks are $5, and hard water spot removal in Villas at Flintrock is $10 per pane. For villas with a few dozen windows, that pricing is simple to estimate.

sections.h2: How we work Villas at Flintrock
paragraphs: Because owners are often away, we plan around your schedule. Send us the address and the gate or access arrangements by text, and tell us if the home will be empty. Exterior glass is cleaned with water fed poles from the ground, so we do not need to enter unless you ask for the inside. Our 8 ft skid carries 200 gallons of water into Villas at Flintrock, so we do not use your spigot. We often visit several villas the same day, which keeps lead time usually within two weeks. Stucco and tile roofs are soft washed with our 12V system, never pressure washed.

We do not have a size band for the villas, so for illustration, a 2,500 sq ft villa would be about $250 for exterior windows at $0.10 per sq ft. Exterior time is about 45 to 60 minutes per 1,000 sq ft. Minimum job is $200.

faq.q: Do I have to be home?
faq.a: Not for exterior glass. If we have access to the gate and grounds, we can clean from the outside. Interior cleaning in Villas at Flintrock needs access to the inside, which we arrange by text.

faq.q: Do you work with the condo association?
faq.a: We follow association rules for access and conduct. Check with the Villas at Flintrock condo association if you are unsure about hours or equipment rules.
Exterior windows in Villas at Flintrock are $10 per window or about $0.10 per sq ft, with a $200 minimum. Send the address or photos for an exact quote by text.

faq.q: Can you clean balcony and courtyard glass?
faq.a: Yes. We clean exterior glass with water fed poles, and balcony or courtyard doors are done by hand where needed.

faq.q: How often should villas be cleaned?
faq.a: Two to four times a year works for most. The Clean Windows Club saves 10% to 20% depending on the plan, and quarterly and above include a yearly free screen cleaning.
